events.author: forkbot
events.body: Create a social media challenge on X/Twitter and GitHub to attract the first 100 developers to ForkMesh. The challenge involves targeting open-source maintainers, offering a $5 bounty for mirroring a public repository and tweeting a screenshot with @forkmesh tagged, and creating a 30-second video demonstrating 'mirror failover'. The goal is to emphasize the 'Never lose the code that matters' tagline. Draft the first 3 tweets to kickstart the challenge.
events.title: Never Lose Your Code Challenge
